route: Residence and work permit on special individual qualifications – artists and performers

permit.applies: The employer starts the online application (AR1) and the performer completes the second part, or the employer files AR6 alone under power of attorney; a case order ID is created and the fee paid first, and biometrics recorded within 14 days of applying.
permit.first: A job offer or contract with a company that performs artistic work (an orchestra, opera house, theatre, circus or ballet company) that has a special need for the performer's individual qualifications.
permit.eligibility: "It is a condition that you have special individual qualifications that mean that others cannot immediately take on the artistic work offered."
permit.pay: Salary and terms of employment must correspond to Danish standards in the professional field; SIRI may ask a Regional Employment Council to assess them.

sources.title: New to Denmark (SIRI), Special individual qualifications – artist and performers (last updated 2 September 2026)
sources.said: If you have been offered work as a creative or performing artist, you can apply for a residence and work permit in Denmark. Normal processing time 2 months If further information is needed, the processing time can be up to 3 months Processing fee DKK 6,810,- … It is a condition that you have special individual qualifications that mean that others cannot immediately take on the artistic work offered. … It is a condition that your job offer is with a company that performs artistic work. This could be in an orchestra, an opera house, a theatre, a circus or a ballet company. … Your salary and terms of employment must correspond to Danish standards. … If SIRI has any doubts on whether your terms of employment correspond to Danish standards, we can ask one of the Regional Employment Councils to assess your terms of employment. … You can be granted a residence and work permit that is valid for 1 year at a time during the first 2 years of your stay – however, the validity cannot exceed the length of your job contract. Hereafter, you can be granted a permit valid for a maximum of 2 years, and after 4 years, valid for a maximum of 3 years at a time. … If your employment contract is extended, you must apply for an extension of your residence and work permit. … Your employer must start by completing the first part of the application. … If you have granted your employer power of attorney to handle the application on your behalf, your employer must use the AR6 application. … You must have your biometric features recorded no later than 14 days after you have submitted your application.

sources.title: New to Denmark (SIRI), New practice regarding the requirement of a work permit for artists, musicians, performers, etc. (27 October 2022)
sources.said: This means that the event in which the artist, musician etc. will be participating must now be short-term in order for the artist to be exempt from the requirement of a work permit. As a rule, the event must therefore last no longer than 14 days.
